9// Helper

11
12bool check(
13    bool condition,
14    const std::string& message
15)
16{
17    if(condition)
18    {
19        std::cout << "  PASS: " << message << std::endl;
20        return true;
21    }
22
23    std::cout << "  FAIL: " << message << std::endl;
24    return false;
25}

28// ============================================================
29// Test RadioactiveDecayReader
30// ============================================================
31
32bool test_radioactive_decay_reader()
33{
34    std::cout
35        << "\n"
36        << "============================================\n"
37        << " Testing RadioactiveDecayReader\n"
38        << "============================================\n";
39
40    bool success = true;
41
42    RadioactiveDecayReader reader(
43        "RadioactiveDecay5.5"
44    );
45
46    // --------------------------------------------------------
47    // Check data directory
48    // --------------------------------------------------------
49
50    success &= check(
51        reader.dataDirectory() == "RadioactiveDecay5.5",
52        "Data directory"
53    );
54
55
56    // --------------------------------------------------------
57    // Check file path
58    // --------------------------------------------------------
59
60    const std::string path =
61        reader.filePath(12, 22);
62
63    std::cout
64        << "  File: "
65        << path
66        << std::endl;
67
68    success &= check(
69        path.find("z12.a22") != std::string::npos,
70        "22Mg file path"
71    );
72
73
74    // --------------------------------------------------------
75    // Read 22Mg
76    // --------------------------------------------------------
77
78    RadioactiveIsotope mg22 =
79        reader.read(12, 22);
80
81    success &= check(
82        mg22.atomicNumber() == 12,
83        "Atomic number Z = 12"
84    );
85
86    success &= check(
87        mg22.massNumber() == 22,
88        "Mass number A = 22"
89    );
90
91
92    // --------------------------------------------------------
93    // Parent states
94    // --------------------------------------------------------
95
96    std::cout
97        << "  Number of parent states: "
98        << mg22.numberOfParentStates()
99        << std::endl;
100
101    success &= check(
102        mg22.numberOfParentStates() > 0,
103        "At least one parent state"
104    );
105
106    if(mg22.numberOfParentStates() == 0)
107        return false;
108
109
110    // --------------------------------------------------------
111    // First parent state
112    // --------------------------------------------------------
113
114    const auto& parent =
115        mg22.parentStates().front();
116
117    std::cout
118        << "\n"
119        << "  First parent state:\n"
120        << "    Energy:    "
121        << parent.energy_keV
122        << " keV\n"
123        << "    Floating:  "
124        << parent.floating
125        << "\n"
126        << "    Half-life: "
127        << parent.halfLife_s
128        << " s\n";
129
130
131    // --------------------------------------------------------
132    // 22Mg half-life
133    // --------------------------------------------------------
134
135    success &= check(
136        std::abs(parent.halfLife_s - 3.8755) < 1.0e-4,
137        "22Mg half-life = 3.8755 s"
138    );
139
140
141    // --------------------------------------------------------
142    // Decay modes
143    // --------------------------------------------------------
144
145    std::cout
146        << "\n"
147        << "  Decay modes: "
148        << parent.numberOfDecayModes()
149        << std::endl;
150
151    success &= check(
152        parent.numberOfDecayModes() > 0,
153        "At least one decay mode"
154    );
155
156
157    double totalBranching = 0.0;
158    bool foundBetaPlus = false;
159    bool foundEC = false;
160
161
162    for(const auto& mode : parent.decayModes)
163    {
164        std::cout
165            << "\n"
166            << "    Mode: "
167            << mode.decayType
168            << "\n"
169            << "      Branching fraction: "
170            << mode.totalBranchingFraction
171            << "\n"
172            << "      Number of channels: "
173            << mode.numberOfChannels()
174            << std::endl;
175
176        totalBranching +=
177            mode.totalBranchingFraction;
178
179
180        // ----------------------------------------------------
181        // Beta+
182        // ----------------------------------------------------
183
184        if(mode.decayType == "BetaPlus")
185        {
186            foundBetaPlus = true;
187
188            success &= check(
189                std::abs(
190                    mode.totalBranchingFraction
191                    -
192                    0.99918
193                ) < 1.0e-5,
194                "BetaPlus branching fraction = 0.99918"
195            );
196        }
197
198
199        // ----------------------------------------------------
200        // Electron capture
201        // ----------------------------------------------------
202
203        if(
204            mode.decayType == "KshellEC" ||
205            mode.decayType == "LshellEC" ||
206            mode.decayType == "MshellEC" ||
207            mode.decayType == "NshellEC"
208        )
209        {
210            foundEC = true;
211        }
212
213
214        // ----------------------------------------------------
215        // Channels
216        // ----------------------------------------------------
217
218        for(std::size_t i = 0;
219            i < mode.channels.size();
220            ++i)
221        {
222            const auto& channel =
223                mode.channels[i];
224
225            std::cout
226                << "        Channel "
227                << i
228                << ":\n"
229                << "          Daughter energy: "
230                << channel.daughterEnergy_keV
231                << " keV\n"
232                << "          Floating: "
233                << channel.daughterFloating
234                << "\n"
235                << "          Branching: "
236                << channel.branchingPercentage
237                << " %\n"
238                << "          Q: "
239                << channel.qValue_keV
240                << " keV"
241                << std::endl;
242
243            success &= check(
244                channel.branchingPercentage >= 0.0,
245                "Channel branching percentage >= 0"
246            );
247
248            success &= check(
249                channel.modeFraction() >= 0.0 &&
250                channel.modeFraction() <= 1.0,
251                "Channel branching fraction in [0,1]"
252            );
253        }
254    }
255
256
257    success &= check(
258        foundBetaPlus,
259        "BetaPlus decay mode found"
260    );
261
262
263    if(foundEC)
264    {
265        std::cout
266            << "  PASS: Electron-capture mode found"
267            << std::endl;
268    }
269    else
270    {
271        std::cout
272            << "  INFO: No separate electron-capture "
273            << "mode found"
274            << std::endl;
275    }
276
277
278    // --------------------------------------------------------
279    // Branching normalization
280    // --------------------------------------------------------
281
282    std::cout
283        << "\n"
284        << "  Total decay-mode branching: "
285        << totalBranching
286        << std::endl;
287
288    success &= check(
289        std::abs(totalBranching - 1.0) < 1.0e-3,
290        "Decay branching fractions approximately sum to 1"
291    );
292
293
294    // --------------------------------------------------------
295    // Parent-state lookup
296    // --------------------------------------------------------
297
298    const auto& lookup =
299        mg22.parentState(parent.energy_keV);
300
301    success &= check(
302        std::abs(
303            lookup.energy_keV -
304            parent.energy_keV
305        ) < 1.0e-9,
306        "Parent-state lookup by energy"
307    );
308
309
310    return success;
311}

314// ============================================================
315// Test PhotonTransition
316// ============================================================
317
318bool test_photon_transition()
319{
320    std::cout
321        << "\n"
322        << "============================================\n"
323        << " Testing PhotonTransition\n"
324        << "============================================\n";
325
326    bool success = true;
327
328    std::array<double, 10> shells{};
329
330    PhotonTransition transition(
331        1,
332        583.0,
333        100.0,
334        3,
335        0.0,
336        0.0,
337        shells
338    );
339
340
341    success &= check(
342        transition.daughterLevel == 1,
343        "Daughter level"
344    );
345
346    success &= check(
347        std::abs(
348            transition.energy_keV - 583.0
349        ) < 1.0e-9,
350        "Gamma energy"
351    );
352
353    success &= check(
354        std::abs(
355            transition.relativeIntensity - 100.0
356        ) < 1.0e-9,
357        "Relative intensity"
358    );
359
360    success &= check(
361        transition.multipolarity == 3,
362        "Multipolarity"
363    );
364
365    success &= check(
366        std::abs(
367            transition.gammaProbability() - 1.0
368        ) < 1.0e-12,
369        "Gamma probability for alpha = 0"
370    );
371
372    success &= check(
373        std::abs(
374            transition.conversionProbability()
375        ) < 1.0e-12,
376        "Conversion probability for alpha = 0"
377    );
378
379
380    // --------------------------------------------------------
381    // Test internal conversion
382    // --------------------------------------------------------
383
384    PhotonTransition converted(
385        1,
386        100.0,
387        50.0,
388        3,
389        0.0,
390        1.0,
391        shells
392    );
393
394    success &= check(
395        std::abs(
396            converted.gammaProbability() - 0.5
397        ) < 1.0e-12,
398        "Gamma probability for alpha = 1"
399    );
400
401    success &= check(
402        std::abs(
403            converted.conversionProbability() - 0.5
404        ) < 1.0e-12,
405        "Conversion probability for alpha = 1"
406    );
407
408    success &= check(
409        std::abs(
410            converted.gammaProbability()
411            +
412            converted.conversionProbability()
413            -
414            1.0
415        ) < 1.0e-12,
416        "Gamma + conversion probability = 1"
417    );
418
419
420    return success;
421}

424// ============================================================
425// Test PhotonLevel
426// ============================================================
427
428bool test_photon_level()
429{
430    std::cout
431        << "\n"
432        << "============================================\n"
433        << " Testing PhotonLevel\n"
434        << "============================================\n";
435
436    bool success = true;
437
438    PhotonLevel level(
439        0,
440        "-",
441        0.0,
442        -1.0,
443        0.0
444    );
445
446
447    success &= check(
448        level.id == 0,
449        "Level ID"
450    );
451
452    success &= check(
453        level.isStable(),
454        "Stable level"
455    );
456
457    success &= check(
458        level.hasKnownJPi(),
459        "Known JPi"
460    );
461
462    success &= check(
463        level.numberOfGammas() == 0,
464        "Initial gamma count"
465    );
466
467
468    std::array<double, 10> shells{};
469
470    level.transitions.emplace_back(
471        0,
472        100.0,
473        1.0,
474        3,
475        0.0,
476        0.0,
477        shells
478    );
479
480
481    success &= check(
482        level.numberOfGammas() == 1,
483        "Gamma count after adding transition"
484    );
485
486
487    return success;
488}

495bool test_photon_evaporation_reader()
496{
497    std::cout
498        << "\n"
499        << "============================================\n"
500        << " Testing PhotonEvaporationReader\n"
501        << "============================================\n";
502
503    bool success = true;
504
505    PhotonEvaporationReader reader(
506        "PhotonEvaporation5.5"
507    );
508
509
510    // --------------------------------------------------------
511    // File path
512    // --------------------------------------------------------
513
514    const std::string path =
515        reader.filePath(12, 22);
516
517    std::cout
518        << "  File: "
519        << path
520        << std::endl;
521
522    success &= check(
523        path.find("z12.a22") != std::string::npos,
524        "22Mg PhotonEvaporation file path"
525    );
526
527
528    // --------------------------------------------------------
529    // Read isotope
530    // --------------------------------------------------------
531
532    PhotonIsotope mg22 =
533        reader.read(12, 22);
534
535    success &= check(
536        mg22.atomicNumber() == 12,
537        "Atomic number Z = 12"
538    );
539
540    success &= check(
541        mg22.massNumber() == 22,
542        "Mass number A = 22"
543    );
544
545
546    // --------------------------------------------------------
547    // Levels
548    // --------------------------------------------------------
549
550    std::cout
551        << "  Number of levels: "
552        << mg22.numberOfLevels()
553        << std::endl;
554
555    success &= check(
556        mg22.numberOfLevels() > 0,
557        "At least one photon level"
558    );
559
560    if(mg22.numberOfLevels() == 0)
561        return false;
562
563
564    // --------------------------------------------------------
565    // Inspect levels
566    // --------------------------------------------------------
567
568    for(const auto& level : mg22.levels())
569    {
570        std::cout
571            << "\n"
572            << "    Level "
573            << level.id
574            << ":\n"
575            << "      Energy:    "
576            << level.energy_keV
577            << " keV\n"
578            << "      Floating:  "
579            << level.floating
580            << "\n"
581            << "      Half-life: "
582            << level.halfLife_s
583            << " s\n"
584            << "      JPi:       "
585            << level.jpi
586            << "\n"
587            << "      Gammas:    "
588            << level.numberOfGammas()
589            << std::endl;
590
591
592        for(const auto& gamma : level.transitions)
593        {
594            std::cout
595                << "        Gamma:\n"
596                << "          Daughter: "
597                << gamma.daughterLevel
598                << "\n"
599                << "          Energy:   "
600                << gamma.energy_keV
601                << " keV\n"
602                << "          Intensity: "
603                << gamma.relativeIntensity
604                << "\n"
605                << "          Multipolarity: "
606                << gamma.multipolarity
607                << "\n"
608                << "          Mixing ratio:  "
609                << gamma.mixingRatio
610                << "\n"
611                << "          Alpha:          "
612                << gamma.conversionCoefficient
613                << std::endl;
614
615
616            success &= check(
617                gamma.energy_keV >= 0.0,
618                "Gamma energy >= 0"
619            );
620
621            success &= check(
622                gamma.relativeIntensity >= 0.0,
623                "Gamma intensity >= 0"
624            );
625
626            success &= check(
627                gamma.gammaProbability() >= 0.0 &&
628                gamma.gammaProbability() <= 1.0,
629                "Gamma probability in [0,1]"
630            );
631
632            success &= check(
633                gamma.conversionProbability() >= 0.0 &&
634                gamma.conversionProbability() <= 1.0,
635                "Conversion probability in [0,1]"
636            );
637
638            success &= check(
639                std::abs(
640                    gamma.gammaProbability()
641                    +
642                    gamma.conversionProbability()
643                    -
644                    1.0
645                ) < 1.0e-12,
646                "Gamma + conversion probability = 1"
647            );
648        }
649    }
650
651
652    // --------------------------------------------------------
653    // Level lookup
654    // --------------------------------------------------------
655
656    const int firstID =
657        mg22.levels().front().id;
658
659    const auto& lookup =
660        mg22.level(firstID);
661
662    success &= check(
663        lookup.id == firstID,
664        "Level lookup by ID"
665    );
666
667
668    return success;
669}
